  PROBLEM: Every successful `prepare` writes `REVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT_PATHS_FILE=` (usually with an empty value) to GITHUB_ENV after the `REVIEW_SANDBOX_ROOT=` line, because the switch is on by default. Existing test parsers that take "everything after `REVIEW_SANDBOX_ROOT=`" then read the two-line value `<root>\nREVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT_PATHS_FILE=`. The parsers are at tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:9879, tests/test_review_sandbox_install_timeout.py:79 and tests/test_review_sandbox_build_retry.py:89.
  WHY: The `run` root check at review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:476-486 (`root_pattern_mismatch`) rejects the corrupted root with `::error::Review sandbox not prepared`. That error fails `test_review_isolation_transfers_into_active_work_tree` at tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:9891 in `tests-system-python (23)` and `orchestrate-poll (1)` on head 3117755a, and `lint` goes red as a result. In the timeout and build_retry tests, the `_cleanup` helpers get the corrupted root and leak sandbox roots without failing. This PR caused the regression: on the merge base, prepare wrote only the root line. All reviewers rated it BLOCKER, which maps to critical here.
- tests/test_github_ai_plan_grant_write.py:621 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The contract assertion `assert root_export < grant_export < sandbox.index("trap - EXIT", root_export)` locks in the broken order: `REVIEW_SANDBOX_ROOT` first, then `REVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT_PATHS_FILE`.
  WHY: Any reorder that fixes the runtime regression fails this test, so the printf and the assertion have to be flipped together. The reviewer rated it BLOCKER, which maps to critical here. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash mention the same assertion (line 619 onward / 619-620) only as part of the fix for the finding above.

  PROBLEM: `prepare` writes `REVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT_PATHS_FILE=` (usually empty) after `REVIEW_SANDBOX_ROOT=`, because the switch is on by default. Three test parsers then get `<root>\nREVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT_PATHS_FILE=` as the root:

    - tests/test_review_sandbox_install_timeout.py:79

  WHY: The `run` root check at review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:476-477 (`root_pattern_mismatch`) rejects the value, and line 486 prints `::error::Review sandbox not prepared`. That is the failure at tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:9891 in `tests-system-python (23)` and `orchestrate-poll (1)` on head 3117755a, and it makes `lint` red. Production consumers are unaffected: review_conflict_resolve.sh:1270 and review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:1141 use `sed -n 's/^REVIEW_SANDBOX_ROOT=//p' | tail -n 1`.
